partners.mechanism_chain: NIPA1 (HGNC:28027) —DISRUPTS→ Intracellular calcium homeostasis (GO:0005884); Intracellular calcium homeostasis (GO:0005884) —LEADS_TO→ Hereditary spastic paraplegia (HP:0001276); ANKH (HGNC:382) —DISRUPTS→ Pyrophosphate (CHEBI:17590); Pyrophosphate (CHEBI:17590) —INCREASES→ Calcium pyrophosphate deposition in cartilage (GO:0008320); Calcium pyrophosphate deposition in cartilage (GO:0008320) —LEADS_TO→ Chondrocalcinosis (HP:0004604). Loss-of-function mutations in NIPA1 disrupt intracellular calcium homeostasis, leading to hereditary spastic paraplegia. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in ANKH lead to dysregulation of pyrophosphate metabolism, specifically increasing extracellular pyrophosphate levels, which promotes calcium pyrophosphate deposition in cartilage, causing chondrocalcinosis. The convergence lies in the shared downstream impact on cellular mineral homeostasis and tissue integrity, albeit through distinct pathways.

falsification.text: Discovery of individuals with NIPA1 loss-of-function variants who do not exhibit spastic paraplegia, or individuals with ANKH loss-of-function variants who do not exhibit chondrocalcinosis, would weaken this hypothesis.
